modes.label: Choose the briefing
modes.single_tooltip: Process one image or video. The press release has already declared it a success; the software will still check.
modes.batch_tooltip: Process a folder. More files do not make the spokesperson more credible.

gaslight.label: Revise the record
gaslight.tooltip: Overwrite existing output files instead of skipping them. The old press statement has become inconvenient.

ghost.label: Radical transparency
ghost.tooltip: Make detected watermark regions transparent instead of filling them. PNG/WEBP only; enable alpha masking for LoRA training. Actual transparency. The briefing room is horrified.

sigma_detect.label: Maximum region (%)
sigma_detect.tooltip: Skip detections larger than this share of the image. Calling something precise does not change its size.

detection_prompt.label: The official target
detection_prompt.tooltip: Specify watermark, logo, text or signature. The detector needs a description, not a national-security monologue.

output_format.label: Release format
output_format.tooltip: Choose the output format. Auto keeps the image format and uses MP4 for video. Repackaging evidence does not refute it.

detection_skip.label: Detection interval
detection_skip.hint: Higher intervals are faster but may miss brief watermarks. An omission is not an exoneration.

fade_in.label: Earlier buffer
fade_in.hint: Extend removal backward for fading-in watermarks. Context starts before the convenient clip.

fade_out.label: Later buffer
fade_out.hint: Extend removal forward for fading-out watermarks. The footage continues after the briefing ends.

buttons.preview_tooltip: Inspect detection boxes before processing. “Facts don’t care about your feelings.” — Ben Shapiro. Great; let’s look at the actual pixels.

dropzone.title: Original files, please
dropzone.subtitle: Drop files or click. A press statement is not an image.
dropzone.video_hint: Video evidence. Click to change the input.
dropzone.image_hint: Source image. Click to change the input.

preview_modal.title: Independent pixel review
preview_modal.loading_hint: Loading prepared models. Prepare missing downloads in the Models panel.

marquee: MOST MORAL PIXELS IN THE WORLD™ /// WE INVESTIGATED OUR OWN PRESS RELEASE /// ACCOUNTABILITY IS NOT A FILE FORMAT /// FACTS REQUIRE MORE THAN A PODCAST MICROPHONE ///
processing_status: Checking the pixels against the press release…
The spokesperson is deeply concerned about being asked…
An internal review has congratulated the internal review…
“I’m popular and no one has ever heard of you.” — Ben Shapiro, to Andrew Neil. The GPU remains unimpressed…
Precision is a measurement, not a fucking slogan…
A civilian is a person, not a PR inconvenience. Processing pixels…
The evidence has declined an invitation to disappear…
Repairing the background, not the official alibi…
Almost done. The briefing still has no answers.

logs.init: Spokesperson mode. Political satire, actual file processing.
logs.starting: Processing started. No victory statement until the worker succeeds.
logs.first_run_hint: Missing models must be prepared in the Models panel. Rhetoric will not download them.
logs.done: Files processed successfully. A verifiable result; the press office is confused.
logs.stopped: The user stopped processing. No euphemism required.
logs.no_input: No input selected. Even a confident spokesperson needs a file.
logs.ghost_video_warning: Transparent mode is unavailable for video; disabling it. This is a technical limitation, not a classified justification.
logs.no_ffmpeg: FFmpeg is missing. Output video will have no audio. That is a dependency issue, not proof the source was silent.
logs.api_error: API unavailable. Start the app or run.bat/run.sh. Denouncing the question will not fix the bridge.
logs.preview_result: Detected {total} regions; {accepted} are scheduled for removal.
